current_phase.next_action: Module implemented, verified, committed, and ready for release. Remaining manual browser checks are the Phase 05 matrix if desired on real trip data.

audit_findings.finding: trip_documents already has reservation_id (nullable FK) and file_path (nullable string). Three new columns needed for clean UI rendering: original_filename, mime_type, file_size_bytes.
validatedDocument() accepts only title, document_type, expires_on, notes. reservation_id and file_path are never written. No upload action exists anywhere.
Documents tab renders as text-only rows with no file picker, no preview, no download button. Reservation cards (lines 827-925) do not surface attachments at all.
Default disk is 'local' writing to storage/app/private. Files will be private; access must go through a controller (no public URL).
Trip serializer eager loads documents.updatedBy and attaches only last_edited_by. Needs file_url + preview_kind + size_label per document, plus document_count per reservation.
$fillable already includes reservation_id and file_path. Needs original_filename, mime_type, file_size_bytes added. No deleting hook for file cleanup.

decisions_locked_in: File constraints: pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, webp, heic, heif. Max 15 MB per file. Max 10 files per upload request.
Multi-file UX: multi-select or drag-drop creates one document row per file. The existing one-file-per-row schema stays.

Reservation linking surfaces: upload directly from the reservation card (auto-links reservation_id). After-the-fact linking via the existing edit form's new reservation dropdown. No 'attach existing' picker; no reservation dropdown in the documents-tab upload form.
Preview behavior: image thumbnails inline with click-to-enlarge lightbox modal; PDFs open in a new tab via Content-Disposition: inline; HEIC/HEIF treated as download-only (image-opaque preview kind).
File serving: dedicated GET endpoint authorized via the trip view policy. No public URLs, no signed URLs. Same URL serves and new-tab PDF open.
Activity event: document.uploaded (new event type, distinct from document.created for text-only notes). Reuses TripChangedNotification — no new notification class.
Model deleting hook on TripDocument removes the underlying file. Trip force-delete path explicitly iterates documents so cascaded deletes also clean files. Soft-delete leaves files in place.
Dedicated TripDocumentController for upload + file actions. Existing TripPlanningController text-note actions stay in place, gain reservation_id support.
Out-of-scope polish (deferred): cloud storage migration, OCR, antivirus, thumbnail generation, replace-file flow, multi-file-per-record schema, 'attach existing' picker, versioning.
open_questions: Resolved: preview kind label is image-opaque for HEIC/HEIF download-only image files.
Resolved: humanFileSize() lives on TripController for now because it is only serializer output.
Resolved: document row and reservation upload UI stayed inline in Trips/Show.vue to avoid over-extracting during the first implementation.

upload.name: trips.documents.upload

request_body.reservation_id: integer (nullable, must be a reservation on this trip)

upload.success_response: 302 back() with success flash; N rows created in trip_documents; N files written to disk; N document.uploaded activity events

error_responses.validation: 422 with field-level errors on files / files.* / reservation_id / etc.

file.name: trips.documents.file
file.success_response: 200 with Content-Type matching mime_type, Content-Disposition: inline, body streams the file

store_note.name: trips.documents.store
store_note.change: validation rules gain optional reservation_id (must belong to this trip). No file fields accepted via this endpoint.

update.name: trips.documents.update
update.change: validation rules gain optional reservation_id (must belong to this trip). Used for after-the-fact reservation linking from the documents-tab edit form.

destroy.name: trips.documents.destroy
destroy.change: Model deleting hook removes the underlying file from disk.

ux_rules.documents_tab_drop_zone: dashed-border zone at the top of the documents tab; drag-drop or click to pick; stages up to 10 files with size labels; shared title_prefix/document_type/expires_on/notes fields applied to the batch
ux_rules.documents_tab_row_layout: thumbnail/icon on the left (h-16 w-16), title + metadata in the center, download/edit/delete on the right
ux_rules.preview_routing: image -> lightbox modal | pdf -> new tab via target=_blank + Content-Disposition: inline | image-opaque (heic) -> download | file (other) -> download | note -> render text only
ux_rules.lightbox: fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 modal; Esc closes; backdrop click closes; focus returns to the originating thumbnail button
ux_rules.reservation_card_badge: small pill with paperclip icon + count when document_count > 0
ux_rules.reservation_card_attachments_section: collapsible block inside the read-only branch of each reservation card; auto-expanded when document_count > 0; compact upload affordance + linked document rows reusing the DocumentRow markup
ux_rules.edit_form_reservation_dropdown: select with 'Not linked' option plus every trip reservation; used for after-the-fact linking from the documents tab
ux_rules.text_note_form_demoted: existing 'Add document note' form moves into a <details> block titled 'Add a note instead (no file)' to keep visual hierarchy on uploads
ux_rules.upload_progress: inline progress bar driven by Inertia useForm onProgress; reset on success or error

state_owners.upload_form_state: useForm in Trips/Show.vue (documents tab) and a per-card useForm in ReservationAttachmentUpload (Phase 04)
state_owners.upload_progress_state: ref<number | null> in Trips/Show.vue, driven by Inertia onProgress callback
state_owners.lightbox_state: ref<TripDocument | null> in Trips/Show.vue; shared by documents tab and reservation card
state_owners.expanded_reservations_state: ref<Set<number>> in Trips/Show.vue; seeded on mount from document_count, not persisted
state_owners.drop_zone_active_state: ref<boolean> in Trips/Show.vue, toggled by dragenter/dragover/dragleave/drop

Upload/download endpoints live in app/Http/Controllers/TripDocumentController.php, private path generation lives in app/Services/TripDocumentStorage.php, serializer metadata is in TripController, and the documents tab plus reservation attachment sections are in resources/js/pages/Trips/Show.vue.
